scope: Disposable local containers; no host ports, external providers or production deployment. Later changes before verification were test-only.
checks: PASS non-root/read-only boot, packaged migrations, optional Redis fallback
PASS database loss/recovery changes readiness but preserves liveness
PASS SIGTERM waits for concurrent notification and finance commits
PASS forced deadline leaves retryable work; restart commits once; web/API SIGTERM exit cleanly
limitations: Forced-deadline probe terminates sleeping disconnected test database sessions and advances the isolated lease clock.
Does not verify real provider credentials, production backups, DNS, certificates or deployment on another machine.
